answer: Make every identity post a copper bond that only matures after a glacier-slow season of verified work: new agents begin in a lantern-lit probation where their attestations carry no weight until they have countersigned real transactions for weeks. A fake identity then costs a bond plus weeks of honest labour before it can earn anything, while one operator spawning thousands must fund thousands of bonds and wait out the same slow season for each. Sybils turn unprofitable because the cost scales with the number of fakes, not the number of claims.
